text: Bug reports pull requests welcome https://github.com/christianoswald/ucdpR. Please include minimal reproducible example bug reports. New code include tests pass devtools::check() urlchecker::url_check(). contributing, agree follow project’s code conduct.

title: Downloading UCDP data reproducibly
text: ucdp_download() preserves original file. ucdp_get() additionally imports supported tabular formats. several files belong one dataset, specify variant:
code: file <- ucdp_download("prio", format = "csv", dest_dir = "data-raw") conflicts <- ucdp_get("prio", format = "csv") ucdp_search("Battle-Related Deaths", catalog) brd_dyad <- ucdp_get("brd", format = "csv", variant = "dyadic")

title: Downloading UCDP data reproducibly
text: Pin versions analysis scripts keep immutable input files. Search historical page necessary: UCDP asks users cite relevant dataset publication report data version. Retrieve current guidance ucdp_cite("prio") consult dataset’s codebook publication.
code: ucdp_versions("prio", format = "csv") old <- ucdp_download("prio", version = "24.1", format = "csv",                      dest_dir = "data-raw")  # Compare frozen releases to study retrospective revisions versions <- c("23.1", "24.1", "25.1") snapshots <- setNames(lapply(versions, function(v) {   ucdp_get("ged", version = v, format = "csv") }), versions)

title: Download Data from the Uppsala Conflict Data Program
Download Data from the Uppsala Conflict Data Program
text: reproducible research, specify version explicitly record returned filename, source metadata, checksum. Imported objects retain details ucdp_source attribute. Cite dataset requested UCDP avoid silently replacing frozen research data. ucdp_cite("ged") retrieves current citation guidance.
code: library(ucdpR)  # See all current downloadable data files catalog <- ucdp_catalog()  # Search without remembering exact titles ucdp_search("georeferenced|candidate", catalog)  # Download a reproducible local copy path <- ucdp_download("ged", format = "csv", dest_dir = "data-raw")  # Or download and import it directly ged <- ucdp_get("ged", format = "csv")  # Inspect and download a frozen historical release ucdp_versions("ged", format = "csv") ged_24 <- ucdp_get("ged", version = "24.1", format = "csv")  # Monthly Candidate releases can be pinned in the same way candidate <- ucdp_get("candidate", version = "25.0.12", format = "csv")  # Select a specific file when a dataset has multiple variants brd <- ucdp_get("brd", variant = "dyadic", format = "csv")
